mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses equity discount rates by reducing risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: The proportion of negative 20-day forward returns following FEDFUNDS < 0.1% exceeds 60% in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings growth potential, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate policy responses and demand contraction.
failure_condition: The proportion of positive 20-day forward returns following UNRATE > 5.5 exceeds 60% in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS < 600,000 million dollars) and housing starts (HOUST < 1400 thousand units) signal broad-based demand destruction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: The proportion of negative 5-day forward returns following RSAFS < 600,000 and HOUST < 1400 is less than 60% in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 0.5% monthly) during late-cycle expansion regimes (defined by INDPRO growth > 0.5% and GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.5%) signals robust economic momentum, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings accelerate.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes (INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly and GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.5%), the 60-day forward returns of SPX are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High consumer spending (RSAFS > 600,000 million dollars) reflects strong household demand and corporate revenue visibility, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: The proportion of negative 5-day forward returns following RSAFS > 600,000 million dollars exceeds 60% in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and reducing risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks materialize.
failure_condition: The proportion of positive 60-day forward returns following FEDFUNDS > 4.5 exceeds 60% in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) and weak job growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.1% monthly) indicate labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate hiring expectations decline.
failure_condition: The proportion of negative 20-day forward returns following UNRATE > 5.5 and PAYEMS growth < 0.1% is less than 60% in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year inflation below 2.0% (derived from CPIAUCSL) indicates disinflationary pressures, reducing the likelihood of aggressive rate hikes and supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as central bank policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: In periods where year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation is below 2.0%, the 5-day forward returns of SPX are negative in more than 60% of cases.
